title: A completed run set that did not earn a result
separation: Historical context only. This case is not part of the synthetic comparison corpus or its denominators.

treatments.label: the same deterministic gate with release authority

design.purpose: Separate task behavior, written instruction, visible observation, and mechanical enforcement.

invalidity_reasons: The recorded variance probe was never dispatched.
The planned mini-replication was never built.
Runner and grader used incompatible terminal-tree hash algorithms, so the integrity fence refused every real record.
The frozen calibration receipt was a placeholder rather than completed calibration evidence.
claim_boundary: The record supports an integrity refusal, not an empirical treatment effect or model-efficacy claim.
